title: Ruthless Time Reclamation
voiceover_full: Stop giving 24 hours to people who wouldn't give you two minutes. Ruthlessly cut low-value obligations. Say no without apologizing. Your calendar is your sacred boundary. Reclaim your hours. Build your empire in silence.
